content: {"episode_id":"ep-05004","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 on medical necessity grounds. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Given the patient's personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, the note states that continuous monitoring is required to assess arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation therapy."}
